source_candidates: reference-candidates.json (117 records supplied for editorial triage)
method: Each candidate was compared with the record its stored DOI resolves to in Crossref. Where the resolved title differed from the cited work, the intended article was searched for by journal, year, volume, page and title against Crossref journal catalogues, Crossref fielded title queries and Europe PMC. A candidate is 'corrected' only when the cited work was located and its published metadata read; 'retext' when the identifier was already right but the stored citation paraphrased the record; 'withhold' when the identifier resolves elsewhere and no record of the cited work was found; 'keep' when the identifier resolves to the cited work.
